package.name: aav_stop_sign_rs
package.description: stop_sign_watcher in Rust (rclrs): the default since 17 Nov (Ben: "I don't think we want to do this again later"), in place of aav_detector's Python one (removed 22 Nov 2026). The same node name, topics and parameters: the detector's boxes become twist_mux's stop-sign lock (/perception/stop_sign) and the sign's point (/perception/stop_sign/distance). The rules are the stop-sign-core crate, with no ROS, checked against stop_sign.py's answers.
